IT Infrastructure Costs In the early stage of business development, due to the lack of unified IT infrastructure planning, Synagie built a data lake and data warehouse using solutions from two separate software vendors, but these two sets of data systems cannot interact or coordinate with each other.
Two different data systems processing data resulted in data silos, leading to limited productivity and collaboration between systems.
